name: OpenSWE1R
description:
OpenSWE1R is an open-source modern port and reimplementation of Star Wars Episode I: Racer (1999). It allows players to pilot high-speed podracers natively on modern Linux PCs with modern display and controller support.

Features:
- Native Linux execution with support for high resolutions and modern widescreen aspect ratios
- Smooth, uncapped framerate rendering eliminating vintage frame rate drops
- Modern gamepad and flight stick support with analog steering and throttle
- High-fidelity audio playback reproducing original sound effects and John Williams score
- Requires original Star Wars Episode I: Racer game data files to play
